description: A four-panel composite figure (labelled (a)-(d)) comparing EBSD-derived reconstructed microstructures and GOS/DRX maps with 3D cellular-automaton (CA) simulated microstructures of low-alloy steel deformed at 0.01 s⁻¹. (a) Two columns of colour grain maps (top, reconstructed microstructure) each paired with a GOS/DRX-fraction map (bottom, predominantly blue with isolated green recrystallised grains): left, constant 1050 °C at 0.5 strain, "0.5 strain: 80.01±4.30μm", "DRX fraction: 98.6%"; right, temperature increasing 950→1050 °C in strain range ε=0.4, "0.5 strain: 62.63±4.11μm", "DRX fraction: 97.3%". (b) Reconstructed microstructures at 0.9 strain: 1050 °C "0.9 strain: 81.30±4.39μm" (left) vs 950→1050 °C "0.9 strain: 79.69±4.78μm" (right). (c) Two 3D simulated cubes at 1050 °C: 0.5 strain 79.79 μm (98.2%) and 0.9 strain 79.89 μm (98.6%). (d) Two 3D simulated cubes for 950→1050 °C: 0.5 strain 65.61 μm (99.5%) and 0.9 strain 75.90 μm (99.8%), coloured white=matrix, green=first stage (950 °C 0.01s⁻¹), red=second stage (1050 °C 0.01s⁻¹). All panels carry 100 μm scale bars; X–Y–Z axes are drawn bottom-left. The figure demonstrates that the CA simulation reproduces the experimental grain sizes and DRX fractions under both constant and increasing temperature.

observations.observation: The caption states the figure compares experimental (reconstructed) and simulated microstructure evolutions under constant and increasing temperatures at 0.01 s⁻¹, panels (a)-(d).
Panel (a) prints DRX fraction 98.6% for constant 1050 °C and 97.3% for 950→1050 °C at 0.5 strain.
Panel (a) prints mean grain sizes of 80.01±4.30μm (1050°C_0.01s⁻¹) and 62.63±4.11μm (950°C_1050°C_0.01s⁻¹, ε₁=0.4) at 0.5 strain.
Panel (b) prints 0.9-strain grain sizes of 81.30±4.39μm (constant 1050 °C) and 79.69±4.78μm (increasing 950→1050 °C).
Panel (c) prints simulated grain sizes 79.79μm (0.5 strain) and 79.89μm (0.9 strain) with DRX fractions 98.2% and 98.6% at constant 1050 °C.
Panel (d) prints simulated grain sizes 65.61μm (0.5 strain) and 75.90μm (0.9 strain) with DRX fractions 99.5% and 99.8% for the increasing-temperature case.
The lower panels of (a) are DRX-fraction maps dominated by blue (non-recrystallised) with small isolated green regions (recrystallised).
Every micrograph panel carries a 100 μm scale bar.
The figure legend at the bottom states 'White grains: matrix', 'Green grains: first stage(950°C 0.01s⁻¹)' and 'Red grains: second stage(1050°C 0.01s⁻¹)'.
The caption refers to panel (a)/(b) contents as reconstructed microstructure with corresponding GOS maps.
The citing text asserts Table 5 presents accuracy evaluation of flow stress, AGS and DRX fraction using 3D CA, and that the model accurately captured AGS and DRX fraction evolution.

subfigures.description: Two columns. Top row: reconstructed colour grain maps (GOS-style) for 1050°C_0.01s⁻¹ (0.5 strain: 80.01±4.30μm) and 950°C_1050°C_0.01s⁻¹(ε₁=0.4) (0.5 strain: 62.63±4.11μm). Bottom row: corresponding DRX-fraction maps, mostly blue with sparse green grains, labelled DRX fraction 98.6% (left) and 97.3% (right). 100 μm scale bars.
Two reconstructed colour microstructures at 0.9 strain: left 1050°C_0.01s⁻¹ with 0.9 strain: 81.30±4.39μm; right 950°C_1050°C_0.01s⁻¹(ε₁=0.4) with 0.9 strain: 79.69±4.78μm. 100 μm scale bars.
Two 3D CA-simulated microstructure cubes for constant 1050 °C: 0.5 strain: 79.79μm (98.2%) and 0.9 strain: 79.89μm (98.6%). Coloured grains on cube faces, 100 μm scale bars.

Two 3D CA-simulated microstructure cubes for increasing temperature 950→1050 °C: 0.5 strain: 65.61μm (99.5%) and 0.9 strain: 75.90μm (99.8%). Colour coding white=matrix, green=first stage (950 °C), red=second stage (1050 °C). X–Y–Z axes shown bottom-left; 100 μm scale bars.
